oneAwardPerSourceCourse.basis: Every equivalency placed in more than one requirement of this program carries the school-published single-award condition.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Current published WGU agreements7112rev186(Sophia)and4429rev114(Study.com) explicitly bind the included outside courses to Business Management202605. Their program-specific receiving awards supersede older provider-only candidates; original source-credit quantities remain separate.

General education is labeled only where the retained official guide identifies the course under that heading. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements; provider subject labels are not treated as university degree categories.
The November 2026 university catalog independently verifies all 36 named WGU course codes, their competency-unit amounts and the 110-CU BSMGT 202605 total.

The program-specific guideline identifies eight nontransferable WGU courses totaling 26 CU, including the 4-CU QGT1 capstone. These are enforced as university-only; this is distinct from the broader residency sufficient check.
Current core term charges are $3,850 tuition plus $200 resource fee per six months, with a separate $65 application fee. Personal completion timing remains a pace scenario, not a promise.

Primary WGU handbook23797, updatedSeptember18,2026, requires25%ofdegreeCUs directly within the active program in addition to capstone; for this110CUledger the verified calculated floor is31.5CU including QGT1.

The executable outside options are limited to source codes printed in the currently published approved program240 agreements. The same original learning action cannot satisfy two receiving requirements.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify certifications for each program by going to General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

notes: $4,050 per six-month term combines $3,850 tuition and the $200 resource fee. The $65 application fee is separate and is not charged each term.
Outside learning, optional costs, financial aid, discounts and individual remaining-term count are not included. A six-month billing period is not a guaranteed degree completion time.

alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative learning shares the overall ceiling; no additional credit allowance is added on top.
